spec_match.rationale: Presents the exact three WGSL forms — unmodified frag_depth, greater, less — with real compilation via createShaderModule/getCompilationInfo when a device exists, which is the precise surface Chrome 154 adds.

interactive.rationale: A compile button attempts real compilation; on this GPU-less machine it reported per-form 'not compiled — no adapter available' rather than fabricating verdicts, which is the designed honest path.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises compiler diagnostics when a GPU exists and an honest refusal when not, which matches observed behaviour.

edge_cases.rationale: The no-device path is explicit per form, and the semantic notes explain the driver-assumption consequences of each form independently of compilation.

conformance.rationale: The suite's greater/less/unmodified/invented-modifier assertions are these forms; on this adapterless build it ran 3 pass / 4 fail, matching the page's own no-device report (feature-level note: those fails conflate no-device with no-support).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless with --disable-gpu (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): clicked compile — each form honestly reported 'not compiled — WebGPU is present but no adapter is available', with the detail explicitly refusing to guess the compiler's verdict; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs the no-device outcome per attempt.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, per-form panels with code and status text, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Code blocks are focusable, per-form status is text, detail is aria-live, compile button is 44px.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read).

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/webgpu-wgsl-fragment-depth/shader-forms/ with Chromium 141 headless, --disable-gpu (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp). With no adapter available the page did exactly what its lede promises: it showed the three real WGSL forms with their semantics, attempted compilation, and reported per form that the compiler's verdict cannot be shown on this machine instead of inventing one. On GPU hardware with Chrome 154 the same button produces real getCompilationInfo diagnostics. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; no mobile overflow; feature /conformance/ ran 3 pass / 4 fail consistent with the missing adapter. Clears the bar.
